name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Braket program building an 5-qubit GH
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Braket program building an 5-qubit GHZ circuit, print the circuit diagram, and verify with the state_vector result type that only |0...0> and |1...1> have amplitude. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
